blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — DoubleDragon Corp.’s hospitality unit, Hotel101, is expanding into India with a $64.4-million project expected to become Hyderabad’s largest hotel by room count. Nasdaq-listed Hotel101 Global Holdings Corp. signed definitive binding agreements on Friday with local developer Pooja Crafted Homes to jointly develop the roughly 625-room hotel.
